description.value: Naan Club is a modern Indian bistro in a Coquitlam retail plaza bringing authentic Indian cuisine with westernized hospitality — spanning classic butter chicken and naan through to tandoori sliders and masala fries. The restaurant features a full cocktail bar with signature drinks and a heated lounge patio under development. Dishes can be customized by spice level, making it accessible to a wide range of palates.

address.value: 100 Schoolhouse Street, Unit 102, Coquitlam, BC V3K 6V9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and corroborates the OSM address ('100-102 Schoolhouse St. coquitlam BC') and URL. The website explicitly lists pickup and third-party delivery options (Uber Eats, DoorDash, Skip), confirming takeout. No bike-specific amenities (racks, charging, pump, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere in OSM tags or website content, so those remain null. The website provides two phone numbers not present in OSM.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; website lists two numbers — (604) 474-5581 and (604) 474-5582 — that should be added to the OSM record.
Business name on website ('Naan Club | Modern Indian Bistro') differs from OSM name ('naán club Exquisite Indian Cuisine'); the OSM name is retained per instructions.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a confirmed address, live website, and online ordering. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a sit-down or takeout meal in Coquitlam.
